capabilities: focus on one section of a note at a time
toggle Stille on and off from the left ribbon
see Stille's on/off state in the status bar
toggle it with a configurable hotkey
extras: The README links to external documentation ('Learn more about Stille') and does not describe what section focus actually looks like in the editor; it mainly covers installation and toggling. The author asks readers to buy them a slice of pizza to support continued development.
problem: Obsidian shows the whole note while editing, making it hard to concentrate on just the section you are writing.
summary: Focus-mode plugin that lets you concentrate on your writing one section at a time, toggled from the ribbon, status bar, or a hotkey.
